environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in shared CI/CD cluster. Service exposed via ClusterIP with nginx ingress controller (ingress-nginx v1.5.1) configured with default settings. Ingress resource uses simple path-based routing: path /api/v1/* forwards to pipeline-config-svc:3000. No authentication annotations configured on the ingress resource. Network policy allows ingress from any pod in the ci-runners namespace. Any pipeline job can reach the service endpoint directly.
